scope: Strict audit of all 10 batch-2 GAZ references for exact model/restyle identity and a complete visible front suitable for orthographic reconstruction.
rule: A search-result caption alone is not evidence. Every item uses two independent source pages; side, rear, cropped, obstructed or model-ambiguous candidates are rejected.

items.reason: Both lamps, the split grille, both bumper corners and bonnet are visible. The photographed chrome bumper guard is an accessory and was explicitly excluded.

items.exactVariant: GAZ-69 two-door utility vehicle, early GAZ production type, 1953-1956
items.reason: Museum gallery identifies the GAZ-69 and shows the complete standard front. An earlier candidate with large auxiliary lamps was rejected.
The exact GAZ-A museum car exposes the full radiator, both lamps, bumper corners, fenders and bonnet. Rear and side candidates were rejected.

items.exactVariant: GAZelle Business 2705-type van, 2010-on Business restyle with compact rectangular grille and teardrop lamps
items.reason: Dealer page and independent Commons category support the Business restyle. Pre-2010 GAZelle, Next and NN fronts were excluded to avoid mixing facelifts.

items.exactVariant: GAZelle Next A32R32 all-metal van, first-generation Next front fascia
items.reason: Exact A32R32 listing with complete first-generation Next fascia; Business and NN candidates were rejected.

items.exactVariant: GAZelle NN panel van, production-generation fascia introduced 2021
items.reason: Launch coverage identifies the NN and independently distinguishes it as the new generation; the full production-style front is visible.
The museum page identifies the M1 and the chosen image shows the full grille, both lamps and bumper. A more oblique candidate was rejected.

items.exactVariant: GAZ-M20V Pobeda third series, 1955-1958, broad horizontal chrome grille
items.reason: The broad horizontal grille identifies the third-series M20V. First- and second-series grille designs were explicitly excluded.

items.exactVariant: GAZ Sobol 22177 4WD microbus, short-wheelbase Sobol body with Business-style fascia, 2025 listing
items.reason: The listing explicitly identifies model 22177 Sobol 4WD. GAZelle photos with a similar front were rejected; Sobol cab width, short body and 4WD stance anchor the selection.

items.exactVariant: GAZ Volga Siber sedan, 2008-2010 production front fascia
items.reason: Both sources identify the 2008-2010 Siber and the promotional photograph shows the complete production front.
